{{Top|leg}}
'''Weptec''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer]], Weptec was surprised that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] classified the droid as a [[Class four droid/Legends|class four droid]]. Despite it having military capabilities, it did not have combat programming.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
